evidence.label: EVM node 0.64 release request
evidence.note: Merged July 30 with a passing pipeline and an explicit Tezos X Previewnet requirement.

history.reason: Direct release preparation and an explicit Previewnet dependency produced a high-confidence days horizon.
The canonical protected tag replaced the forecast with a confirmed release.

methodology: Octez, the EVM node, Tezos X Previewnet, Tezos X mainnet, and Tezos L1 protocol proposals are tracked as separate release lanes.
Confidence comes from direct artifacts and coordinated evidence, never raw merge volume or a fake completion percentage.
Q3 2026 is an agent forecast, not a scheduled activation date; Etherlink governance timing begins only after a public proposal exists.
The browser renders this reviewed daily artifact and marks it stale; it does not infer release readiness from GitLab activity.
